changes: UI framework changed from WPF-UI to Avalonia to enable cross platform compatibility.

Changed when the program checks for conflicting participant information. It now happens whenever a participant change is detected while on the participants page, or when the participant page is loaded.
Added a link to the help documents folder to the about page.
Updated the links on the about page removing the links to no longer used packages and adding the new packages that are used.
Added the ability to link chips in reverse order, that is bibs can count down while chips count up.
DNF entries can now be listed as having a location attached to keep track of where a runner dropped.
There is now a switch to show every linked distance or just the main distances for bib pickup numbers on the participants page and the finished/active/dns stats on the timing page.

Downloading participants from the API has a minor overhaul. It now adds duplicates when a bib conflict on a single person is detected instead of clobbering information and it will add a distance if it doesn't recognize the distance.
Added a prompt confirming the user wants to delete participants from the API to ensure it wasn't an accidental button click.
Importing participants should no longer prompt when there are conflicts, it should just import them and the conflicts button should appear allowing the user to deal with it in the main UI.
fixes: Disabling the automatic downloading of remote reads no longer causes the program to freeze for a number of seconds.
Fixed the issues with the 'base the running clock on this distance/wave' combobox.
Reader notification windows are no longer synchronous and should not cause reader disconnects.
Awards and Print pages have been fixed/updated to work properly and across platforms.
Fixed an issue where a secondary program would never overwrite participant information originally downloaded from the API with newer information from the API.
Changed the default dummy bib/chip from a value of '-1' to an empty string to ensure a person isn't accidentally assigned to an unknown chip read.
Fixed a silent error where the program would stop the download of participants from the api if it matched via participant information and not participant ID.
Fixed an issue where looking up a timing location or segment by its details would cause a database error.
Fixed an issue where distance stats would leave out distances that weren't linked to another distance.
Fixed an issue where distance stats could undercount participants when combining linked distances or counting DNS and unknown statuses together.
Fixed an issue where segments added one at a time wouldn't be tracked correctly until the program was restarted.
Fixed an issue where deleted age groups would continue to be used until the program was restarted.
Fixed an issue where changes to an event's name, date, start time, or results API weren't picked up until the program was restarted.
Fixed an issue where changing the start or start/finish options wouldn't fully take effect until the program was restarted.
Fixed an issue where changing a timing system's IP address would leave the old entry behind.
Fixed an issue where saving alarms could create duplicate alarms.
Fixed an issue where removing a chip from a bib could leave names attached to the wrong chip reads.
Fixed an issue where the program would keep reprocessing results when only start times were left unprocessed.
Fixed an error when banning a phone number or email that was already banned.
Fixed an issue where adding several distances at once to the open event could cause an error.
Fixed an issue where switching events could cause an error or show results with the previous event's location and segment names.
Fixed an issue where importing a participant whose address had a comma would add a leading space to the second address line.
Fixed an issue where linked distances weren't ranked using their ranking order in distance based events.
Fixed an issue where removing a chip from a bib wasn't picked up by results processing until the program was restarted, which could leave a runner marked as DNS.
Fixed an issue in backyard ultras where a start read exactly at the end of the start window was counted as a loop finish.
Fixed an issue in backyard ultras where a runner who never finished their first loop was marked DNF on the second loop.
Fixed an issue in backyard ultras where chips not assigned to a bib were marked DNF after their first loop.
Fixed an issue in backyard ultras where DNF results for known participants weren't linked to the participant.
Fixed a potential crash in backyard ultras when processing a DNF for a loop that had been started but not finished.
Fixed an issue where every read from an IPICO reader was marked as a rewind read.
Fixed an issue where reads from an IPICO reader with a reader ID containing a letter were dropped.
Fixed an issue where a DNS result would stop all results from uploading until the program was restarted. DNS results are now uploaded as DNS.
Fixed an issue where databases from older versions of the program couldn't be upgraded.
Fixed several issues with CSV imports: an extra blank column was shown, quoted values kept a trailing space, and a quoted value with a comma at the end of a line was split in two.
Fixed an issue where Excel imports dropped rows after a blank row and columns after an empty column.
Fixed an issue where an alarm removed on the alarms page kept going off until the alarms were saved.
Fixed an issue where a timing system that never finished connecting could take longer than expected to be marked as disconnected.
Fixed an issue where clicking Start Web could cause an error instead of showing how to allow the web server when it couldn't start.

Fixed several issues with the local results web server: viewing a runner's results could break their printable certificate, opening a certificate could replace the runner's results page, participant counts on certificates grew with every refresh, emailed certificates didn't update when results changed, and requests for missing files never got a response.
Fixed an issue where results were uploaded again on every upload cycle when the event only uploads specific distances or is a backyard ultra with DNF entries.
Fixed an issue where stopping and starting remote reads would stop downloading reads.
Fixed an issue where remote reads could be missed on computers in time zones ahead of UTC.
